related.title: Google Willow 延伸練習：三位元重複碼的能力邊界
related.titleEn: Google Willow extension: the limits of a three-bit repetition code
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只在自相關近似幾何衰減時用此閉式；否則估積分自相關時間並報告方法。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the closed form only for roughly geometric correlation decay; otherwise estimate integrated autocorrelation time and document the method. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 枚舉多數決失敗事件並說明單一重複碼不能更正所有量子錯誤。
related.differenceEn: Enumerate majority-vote failures and explain why one repetition code cannot correct arbitrary quantum errors.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。合成能量序列N=1000、一階自相關ρ=0.5；取樣間隔固定。 N有效=1000×(1−0.5)/(1+0.5)。 代入 1000*(1-0.5)/(1+0.5)，得到 333.333 effective samples。長序列且自相關ρᵏ時N有效≈N(1−ρ)/(1+ρ)；不是所有QPU序列都服從AR(1)。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每個資料位元翻轉率p=0.01，無量測錯誤與相關事件。 P失敗=3×0.01²×0.99+0.01³。 代入 3*0.01**2*(1-0.01)+0.01**3，得到 0.000298 logical failure probability。三位元獨立翻轉率p，完美讀出與解碼下失敗率3p²(1−p)+p³；此碼只保護指定錯誤類型。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Synthetic energy seriesN=1000 and lag-one correlationρ=0.5 with fixed interval. Neff=1000×(1−0.5)/(1+0.5). Substituting 1000*(1-0.5)/(1+0.5) gives 333.333 effective samples. For a long sequence with autocorrelationρ^k,Neff≈N(1−ρ)/(1+ρ); actualQPU sequences need not beAR(1). Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Each data bit flipsp=0.01, with no measurement error or correlated events. Pfail=3×0.01²×0.99+0.01³. Substituting 3*0.01**2*(1-0.01)+0.01**3 gives 0.000298 logical failure probability. For three independent flips with probabilityp and perfect readout/decoding, failure is3p²(1−p)+p³; only the selected error type is protected. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 偏置雜訊量子記憶：只更正相位的代價
related.titleEn: Biased-noise quantum memory: the cost of phase-only protection

related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the closed form only for roughly geometric correlation decay; otherwise estimate integrated autocorrelation time and document the method. related.difference: 以三位元相位重複碼說明主導錯誤壓低後，稀有未保護通道仍可能主導。
related.differenceEn: Use a three-qubit phase repetition code to show how rare unprotected errors can dominate after suppression.

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。獨立相位率pZ=0.01，位元率pX=0.0001，完美校驗。 B=3×0.01²×0.99+0.01³+3×0.0001。 代入 3*0.01**2*(1-0.01)+0.01**3+3*0.0001，得到 0.000598 failure probability upper bound。教學聯集上界B=3pZ²(1−pZ)+pZ³+3pX；前項是完美多數決，後項界定任一X錯誤，忽略Y且不宣稱精確總率。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Synthetic energy seriesN=1000 and lag-one correlationρ=0.5 with fixed interval. Neff=1000×(1−0.5)/(1+0.5). Substituting 1000*(1-0.5)/(1+0.5) gives 333.333 effective samples. For a long sequence with autocorrelationρ^k,Neff≈N(1−ρ)/(1+ρ); actualQPU sequences need not beAR(1). Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Independent phase ratepZ=0.01, bit ratepX=0.0001, perfect checks. B=3×0.01²×0.99+0.01³+3×0.0001. Substituting 3*0.01**2*(1-0.01)+0.01**3+3*0.0001 gives 0.000598 failure probability upper bound. Teaching boundB=3pZ²(1−pZ)+pZ³+3pX combines ideal phase majority failure and any-X union bound, ignoringY and not claiming an exact total. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
